reasoning: VendorViewModel.swift:322-324 adds isFreshNetworkOutcome, which is `!outcome.isStale && (outcome.cacheAge ?? .greatestFiniteMagnitude) <= 1`. Its own doc comment (:250-251 of the diff) calls this the 'Same "network, not cache" test lastNetworkFetch uses'. But lastNetworkFetch at VendorViewModel.swift:258 still runs its own inline `(outcome.cacheAge ?? .greatestFiniteMagnitude) <= 1`. The fix copied the rule, including the magic threshold 1, instead of extracting it. There are now two copies of the network-vs-cache test in the same function, 8 lines apart, and they can drift. The fix introduced this duplication; it did not exist before.
required_changes: Extract the cacheAge threshold into one predicate, e.g. `static func isNetworkOutcome(_:) -> Bool { (outcome.cacheAge ?? .greatestFiniteMagnitude) <= 1 }`. Use it at VendorViewModel.swift:258 (lastNetworkFetch) and inside isFreshNetworkOutcome (`!outcome.isStale && isNetworkOutcome(outcome)`), so the `<= 1` rule exists once.
